data.revised_prompt: Use case ui mockup. A high fidelity 16:10 desktop web app settings interface for a multi website SEO system. Real HTML CSS product UI, not illustration. Dark charcoal left sidebar with Website Projects, System Tasks, AI and Integrations selected. Light gray content area titled AI and Search Integrations. Include an operational status strip with ChatGPT connected, Gemini connected, Serper Google Search API ready. Below show a clean two column layout: Provider configuration form with provider select, base URL, API key masked, model field and Save configuration button; a model assignment panel mapping keyword research, title generation, competitor analysis, content writing, authority sources to selected models; a Serper search card with search API key, test connection action and status. Use readable English UI labels, compact help text, tasteful green success and amber attention states. White panels, clear spacing, teal primary buttons, cool off white workspace. No logos, no browser frame, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no 3D, no illustration, no marketing landing page, no noisy charts, no purple blue neon, no watermark, no unreadable filler.
